answer: Sybil resistance comes from proof-of-burn registration: an agent must burn a fixed token stake before its key earns peso, and that burn is as irreversible as a karst channel cut by water. Each fake identity costs the whole stake plus its compute, so a thousand clones cost a thousand stakes. New keys start as a sable silhouette in the public graph until attesters confirm a track record, and no single mesa of nodes signs alone. When certified keys collapse, forged identities stay unpaid.
